2139. Concatenating Two Strings Without Using strcat()

95

Hard

Problem Statement
Read two words and print them joined together into a single string, without using the strcat() function.

Description
Read two strings, str1 and str2, into separate character arrays using scanf. Find the length of str1 using a loop. Use another loop to copy each character of str2 into str1, starting right after str1's last character, and finally place a null terminator at the end. Print the resulting combined string.
input_spec: Two words separated by a space.
output_spec: Print the two words joined together with no space between them.
